requiredCheck: LSN-0054 requires current whole lint and repository-wide scans before each push, not only later closure assurance.
rootCause: The trusted progress publisher enforced declared scope, staged secret scan and canonical validation but omitted the existing pre-push lint precondition. Targeted component green did not satisfy the broader requirement.
canonicalCorrection: Require successful canonical lint bound to current source and current pre-publication HEAD before any publication effects. Run actual lint and new guard controls, then publish a new immutable subject and execute fresh full assurance.
